title: 1950 AHSME Problem 22
statement: Successive discounts of \(10\%\) and \(20\%\) are equivalent to a single discount of:

solutions.text:
Starting from a price of \(100,\) the first discount leaves \(90.\) The second discount leaves \(0.8(90)=72.\) The total reduction is therefore \(100-72=28,\) or \(28\%.\)

Thus, the correct answer is D.
hints: Apply both discounts to a price of \(100\)
After the first discount, the second discount is taken from \(90,\) not from \(100\)
